messages:
Alex M: quick sync: do we build a pluggable burst-credit adapter or extend allocator with a hard-reservation path?
Priya S: pluggable sounds cleaner if by pluggable you mean runtime-swappable per-pool.
Alex M: yes. adapter between admission and accounting so allocator calls a small interface.
Jordan: benefit: fewer allocator branches, easier to A/B new credit algorithms. downside: tiny hop on hot path.
Sam (infra): hop ok if adapter is a trait inlined. main worry: semantics on revoke mid-request. need clear token lifecycle.
Tayla (sre): SRE prefers hard reservations for SLO attribution. credits complicate incident triage.
Alex M: customers want burst without commit; credits reduce fragmentation. aim: both via same interface.
Jordan: propose adapter API: admit(req)->token; charge(token,usage); cancel(token); inspect(tenant)->balance/reserved. allocator trusts token semantics.
Priya S: adapters must emit unified telemetry for Optimize/Console. no divergent metrics models.
Sam (infra): operator guardrails: per-pool adapter binding + limits (max-burst-per-tenant, global-cap). adapters emit policy events for enforcement.
Tayla (sre): hard-reserve adapter should expose strict SLA mode (preempt_protect flag).
Alex M: plan: prototype API + token-bucket adapter in 2 sprints + hard-reserve shim that implements same contract.
Jordan: tests: fuzz admissions under node failures, simulate revoke during inflight, validate per-admit events.
Sam (infra): persistence: serialize adapter state (balances) in control-plane as deltas to survive restarts.
Priya S: action items:
 - Alex: draft API + protobufs by Fri EOD
 - Jordan: test scenarios & harness (start Mon)
 - Sam: persistence schema RFC next week
 - Tayla: SLO templates for hard-reserve vs credit adapters
orch-bot: calendar event "Adapter design sync" added Mon 10:00.
Alex M: leaning pluggable adapters + operator guardrails + hard-reserve shim. keeps allocator simpler.
Tayla (sre): ok if SLO/metrics delivered before GA.
Priya S: will coordinate telemetry mapping with Optimize.
Jordan: i'll open test-plan issue and link Alex's API PR.
Sam (infra): will stub persistence + admin hooks, rough PR next week.
Alex M: closing thread, follow-ups in Monday sync. :thumbsup:
